# Trace Address Research Report

## Scope
- Source rows: undocumented and documented-only rows from [traces_loaded.wave2_annotated.txt](E:\NTK\GhidraBridge\.codex\reports\traces_loaded.wave2_annotated.txt). After those buckets were exhausted in the annotated trace file, the report continues with the highest-hit integrated rows that still lacked direct writeups.
- Priority order: true undocumented raw addresses first, then documented-only groups ordered by aggregate trace hit count.
- Unit of analysis: grouped by containing exported function start when multiple trace PCs fall inside the same function. Raw addresses with no containing export stay as standalone entries.
- Selected trace-backed `MISSING_REF` rows are included when they are direct callees/siblings of the currently researched undocumented or documented-only family and the extra analysis materially clarifies the real owner/integration path.

## Methodology
- Wave2 live resolution was treated as authoritative for whether an item is already integrated.
- IDA-side evidence came from the IDA-backed fields already exported into `resources/exported_data/functions/*.json` (`ida` names, xrefs, caller lists, sizes, and decompilation).
- The local IDA MCP server configuration page was reachable, but this Codex session did not expose callable MCP tool bindings, so the report uses the persisted IDA export data that Wave2 already consumes.
- This means some rows currently labeled `DOCUMENTED_ONLY`, `UNDOCUMENTED`, or `MISSING_REF` in the annotation file are proven stale or overly coarse in the report below once the containing family is researched directly.
